card.name: Units and words just before a time period
card.fires_on: Small words or unit pieces that come right before a time span or frequency, such as 'again', 'mg', 'mL', 'km', 'L' or '/' after a number. The next words are usually 'per year', 'over 2 weeks', 'every week' or '/hr'.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: A measure unit or its last letter after a number, followed by a rate or time span.
modes.example: A rate of hemoglobin rise of greater than 1 g/d<<L>> over 2 weeks may contribute to these

modes.label: Repeat or interval word
modes.description: Words such as 'again' or '/' that introduce a repeated step or a per-time limit.
modes.example: The solution should be inspected for precipitates before admixing, after admixing, and<< again>> before administration.

modes.label: Hyphenated compound
modes.description: The word 'free' after a hyphen in a general-news phrase.
modes.example: many scientists now think the Arctic Ocean could be ice<<-free>> in summer within two decades
